featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Khire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional behavior. They don’t pick up calls during normal business hours and claim they are out of town and only available via text, yet reply on Sunday saying it’s their holiday. They quoted Rs. 12L for a 3-day event including photography and a wedding film, but when I asked what the videography actually includes (short reel, documentary, trailer, etc.), the only response was, “Yes, videography is included.” That level of communication is unacceptable for a service at this price point.

When I raised concerns, they asked for my email to send details even though a PDF could easily be shared on WhatsApp. Only after I said I cannot manage such important discussions over text did they agree to a phone call, and even then the tone felt like they were doing me a favor while on holiday. If you’re on holiday, don’t respond. I’ve dealt with far more reputed and well-known vendors who communicate far more professionally.
